svg.title: Claude on Foundry architecture overview
svg.desc: Editable Azure architecture, original Microsoft Azure SVG icons, tenant/subscription/VNet/subnet boundaries, PaaS outside private-endpoint subnets; design not live evidence.

g.text: Claude on Foundry | identity, inference and network boundaries
Customer-neutral design; Azure icons are Microsoft's originals. Not live deployment evidence.
DIRECTORY TRUST - separate from Azure resource/data roles
Azure CLI needs explicit client trust
Sync UAMI reads; no directory writes
Backend audience; no user redirect URIs
Allowed caller: APIM MI client AND object IDs
Developers never call the resolver directly
Read registry through Cosmos SQL PE
CUSTOMER VNET - OUTBOUND INTEGRATION AND PE NICs
Private DNS links/forwarding; approved NSG/UDR egress. PaaS services remain outside.
Blue: authenticated request dependencies; green dashed: background Graph/read/write; purple: telemetry; gray: network association.
Private endpoints are NICs, not the PaaS service. Outbound VNet integration does not create private inbound ingress.
Optional components are dashed amber. Token-only limits are not dollar-spend guarantees; private-network acceptance is separate.
